# secobserve_license_group_member (Resource)

Grants a user manage rights on a license group: edit it, and add or remove other members and licenses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secobserve_user" "legal" {
  username = "legal-review"
}

resource "secobserve_license_group_member" "legal_review" {
  license_group = secobserve_license_group.permissive.id
  user          = data.secobserve_user.legal.id
  is_manager    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `license_group` (Number) Id of the license group. Immutable: SecObserve rejects moving a membership, so a change replaces it.
- `user` (Number) Id of the user. Use the `secobserve_user` data source to resolve a username. Immutable: a change replaces the membership.

### Optional

- `is_manager` (Boolean) Whether this member can manage the group itself: edit it, and add or remove other members and licenses.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the membership.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = secobserve_license_group_member.legal_review
  id = "4/7"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The membership's natural key: <license group id>/<user id>.
terraform import secobserve_license_group_member.legal_review "4/7"
```
